definitions.explanation: A series of successive defeats without any wins in between. Used in sports, games, competitions, and other contests.

examples.japanese: チームは{今|いま}、5{連敗|れんぱい}{中|ちゅう}だ。
examples.english: The team is currently on a 5-game losing streak.

examples.japanese: {連敗|れんぱい}を{止|と}めたい。
examples.english: I want to stop the losing streak.

examples.japanese: {連敗|れんぱい}が{続|つづ}いてチームの{士気|しき}が{下|さ}がっている。
examples.english: The continuous losses have lowered the team's morale.

examples.japanese: やっと{連敗|れんぱい}を{脱出|だっしゅつ}して{一勝|いっしょう}できた。
examples.english: We finally broke out of the losing streak and got a win.

examples.japanese: 10{連敗|れんぱい}もしたら{監督|かんとく}の{責任|せきにん}が{問|と}われるだろう。
examples.english: If they lose 10 in a row, the manager will surely be held accountable.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{連|れん} (consecutive) + {敗|はい} (defeat)

COUNTING STREAKS:
・2{連敗|れんぱい} (two consecutive losses)
・5{連敗|れんぱい} (five consecutive losses)
・10{連敗|れんぱい} (ten consecutive losses)

RELATED TERMS:
・{連勝|れんしょう} (winning streak) - antonym
・{連続|れんぞく}{敗北|はいぼく} (consecutive defeats - formal)
・スランプ (slump)
・{低迷|ていめい} (being in a slump)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{連敗|れんぱい}{脱出|だっしゅつ} (breaking out of a losing streak)
・{連敗|れんぱい}{地獄|じごく} (losing streak hell - informal)
・{泥沼|どろぬま}の{連敗|れんぱい} (quagmire of consecutive losses)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{連敗|れんぱい}を{止|と}める (to stop a losing streak)
・{連敗|れんぱい}が{続|つづ}く (for losses to continue)
・{連敗|れんぱい}を{脱出|だっしゅつ}する (to escape a losing streak)
・{連敗|れんぱい}を{喫|きっ}する (to suffer consecutive losses - formal)
